title: The Dry Fountain
scene: At 1:10 PM, the plaza fountain pump vanished. The fountain was drained during the festival from 12:50 to 1:30.

suspects.name: Elsie Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the fountain at 1:10, checking the water display.
suspects.contradiction: The fountain was drained at 12:50, and a pump wrench was in Elsie's tote.

suspects.name: Frank Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at my stall at 1:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The stall camera shows Frank at 1:08.

suspects.name: Greta Lund
suspects.testimony: I was sweeping the steps at 1:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The step camera shows Greta at 1:09 and 1:16.

suspects.name: Hank Reed
suspects.testimony: I was by the entrance at 1:10.
suspects.alibiProof: The entrance camera shows Hank at 1:11.
